description: A self-hosted local inference runtime with native, OpenAI-compatible, and Anthropic-compatible APIs. Available model IDs and limits depend on the models installed and loaded on the user's machine.
residency_notes: For this self-hosted API offer, inference runs on the machine or network host chosen by the customer. Downloaded-model inference, chat, documents, and the local server can operate offline; model search, downloads, updates, and separately selected cloud features can require network access.
prompt_training_notes: Prompts, chat histories, and documents processed by downloaded local models remain on the user's device. This metadata describes the local API, not separately selected LM Studio cloud models or web search.
user_identifier_notes: The local inference API does not send a Phaseo-style end-user identifier to LM Studio; authentication, when enabled by the operator, uses a local API token.
regional_pricing_notes: Local inference is $0 from LM Studio and consumes the customer's own compute. Paid LM Studio cloud inference is a separate Bionic feature with its own US-based, per-model token pricing and is not represented by this localhost API offer.

sources.notes: Local prompts, chat histories, and documents remain on-device; separately selected cloud services are processed under zero-data-retention terms.
Native v1 API for local inference and runtime model management.
OpenAI-compatible models, Responses, Chat Completions, Embeddings, and legacy Completions endpoints.
Local inference is free; cloud inference is a separate paid Bionic feature.
Desktop app terms allow personal and internal business use and make third-party model licensing the customer's responsibility.

verification.notes: Verified as a self-hosted local API against LM Studio's developer docs, privacy policy, app terms, and pricing page. Model availability is installation-dependent, so imported example IDs are not treated as a fixed hosted catalogue.
